name: baseline_patchtst
description: Faithful PatchTST baseline for proposal objective 2 ('PatchTST ต้นฉบับ'): Nie et al. (2023) and the official code, adapted only where the task requires (two heads; no RevIN de-normalisation). Same inputs, rows, labels, split, loss and training protocol as v2.01, so the comparison isolates the architecture. The model numbers are blank for Siwat.

protocol.split: official 70/15/15 by date (validation only; test sealed)
protocol.labels: k x sigma_h fitted on training rows

_notes.stop_rule: mean = stop when the 3-horizon mean on the inner hold-out (the score that picks the kept weights) has not improved for patience epochs. Changed from every by Siwat 2026-10-20 04:08 after the first full run kept training past best epoch 17 + 5.
_notes.seeds: 4539913 / 9574315 / 2253758, chosen by Siwat 2026-10-20, replacing 20261015 / 16 / 17 used by E00-E31 and v2 (so runs are no longer paired seed-for-seed with those).
_notes.inputs, loss, training: Copied from configs/v2_01.json (Siwat's choices) so only the architecture differs. Change them here if the baseline should differ.
_notes.paper and code reference values (not dec: L 336 or 512, P 16, S 8, 3 layers, 16 heads, d_model 128, d_ff 256, dropout 0.2 (paper; small datasets: 4 heads, d_model 16, d_ff 128); official code: attn_dropout 0, head_dropout 0.
_notes.fixed: channel independence, RevIN, end padding (N = floor((L-P)/S) + 2), BatchNorm post-norm encoder with GELU, last-patch flatten + linear heads: Nie et al. 2023 and the official code.
